# Modules whose code decides whether a transaction or block is valid. A pull
# request that changes the version (or replace directive) of one of these runs
# the consensus vectors with the old and the new version, and fails if any
# outcome differs, unless a maintainer adds the consensus-change-acknowledged
# label. See scripts/consensus_lib_gate.sh and
# .github/workflows/consensus-lib-gate.yaml.
#
# One module path per line.

github.com/bitcoin-sv/bdk/module/gobdk   # script engine
github.com/bsv-blockchain/go-bt/v2       # transaction parse and serialize
github.com/bsv-blockchain/go-subtree     # merkle trees and subtree metadata
github.com/bsv-blockchain/go-wire        # legacy block and message parse
